faq: Does Triple I support real-time monitoring for emissions?
Yes. EcoHub connects to smart meters, SCADA and asset logs, so emissions figures update as new readings arrive rather than at quarter end.
Can I track water use and recycling?
Water withdrawal, consumption, discharge and recycling rates are tracked and mapped to GRI 303 disclosures automatically.
How do you measure biodiversity impact?
Site locations are screened against protected and sensitive areas, then scored and reported against GRI 304.
Is reporting automated across multiple plants?
Yes. Data is consolidated across plant portfolios and grids, with per-site and group-level reports generated from the same source.
Do you support SFDR or EU taxonomy?
Yes. EU Taxonomy alignment and SFDR-relevant indicators are supported alongside CSRD, ESRS, GRI and ISSB.

faq: How are Scope 1 vs Scope 3 emissions distinguished?
Owned and operated fleet activity is classified as Scope 1; contracted carriers and upstream transport are classified as Scope 3, following the GHG Protocol.
What formats can you ingest for transport data?
Telematics feeds, fuel-card statements, GPS exports, carrier invoices and spreadsheets, plus direct API, SQL and Excel connections.
Can I track emissions per customer or shipment?
Yes. Emissions can be attributed by shipment, route, customer, vehicle or warehouse.
Is this compliant with CSRD and GRI 305?
Yes. Transport emissions are mapped to CSRD E1 and GRI 305 disclosure requirements.
Do you offer route optimization?
EcoHub reports the carbon cost of routes and fleet mixes so teams can compare options; it reports on efficiency rather than dispatching vehicles.
